arrival.text: THE ELDERWork's on the board. Men for hire wait at the posts, and the bar has drink.

ask.name: DR. YUSRA ADEYEMI, THE CHILDREN'S DOCTOR
ask.said: The lab at the fossil beds has a freezer on its own panels that never went warm. Bring me the freezer, empty it first if you have to, and 45 batteries are yours.

client.name: DR. YUSRA ADEYEMI, THE CHILDREN'S DOCTOR
